mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, popup_zone_idx, popup_zone_name, print_seq, use_yn, add_id, add_date, TO_CHAR(start_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(end_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS end_date, org_file_name, server_file_name, file_extension, file_size, link_url, link_target, alt_text, school_use_yn FROM CMS_POPUP_ZONE WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND school_use_yn = 'N' AND start_date <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND end_date >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') ORDER BY print_seq ASC, add_date DESC

SELECT homepage_id, popup_zone_idx, popup_zone_name, print_seq, use_yn, add_id, add_date, TO_CHAR(start_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(end_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS end_date, org_file_name, server_file_name, file_extension, file_size, link_url, link_target, alt_text, school_use_yn FROM CMS_POPUP_ZONE WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND popup_zone_idx = #{popup_zone_idx}
